MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[pf:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)
WITH p, t, DATE_DIFF('year', CAST(p.birth_date AS DATE), DATE('2026-10-14')) AS age
WHERE age >= 42
   OR t.team_name <> 'Philadelphia 76ers'
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) >= 0
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) > 0
RETURN CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS col1,
       age AS col2,
       t.team_name AS col3,
       p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)
WITH p, t,
     CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_year,

     CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) AS birth_day

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)
WITH p, t,
     CASE
       WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, '/') THEN STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d')
       ELSE STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%B %-d, %Y')
     END AS dob
WITH p, t,
     2026 - CAST(DATE_PART('year', dob) AS INT64)
       - CASE
           WHEN CAST(DATE_PART('month', dob) AS INT64) > 10
             OR (CAST(DATE_PART('month', dob) AS INT64) = 10
                 AND CAST(DATE_PART('day', dob) AS INT64) > 14)
           THEN 1 ELSE 0
         END AS age
WHERE age >= 42
   OR (t.team_name IS NOT NULL AND t.team_name <> 'Philadelphia 76ers')
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) >= 0
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) > 0
RETURN CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS col1,
       age AS col2,
       t.team_name AS col3,
       p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)
WITH p, t,
     CAST(RIGHT(p.birth_date, 4) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
     CASE
       WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, '/') THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
       WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, 'January') THEN 1
       WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, 'February') THEN 2
       WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, 'March') THEN 3
       WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, 'April') THEN 4
       WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, 'May') THEN 5
       WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, 'June') THEN 6
       WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, 'July') THEN 7
       WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, 'August') THEN 8
       WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, 'September') THEN 9
       WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, 'October') THEN 10
       WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, 'November') THEN 11
       WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, 'December') THEN 12
     END AS birth_month,
     CASE
       WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, '/') THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64)
       ELSE CAST(replace(split_part(p.birth_date, ' ', 2), ',', '') AS INT64)
     END AS birth_day
WITH p, t,
     2026 - birth_year - CASE
       WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1
       ELSE 0
     END AS age
WHERE age >= 42
   OR (t.team_name IS NOT NULL AND t.team_name <> 'Philadelphia 76ers')
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) >= 0
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) > 0
RETURN CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS col1,
       age AS col2,
       t.team_name AS col3,
       p.name AS name_player
